Jerel Velarde

Staff Applied AI Engineer · AI Agents & Generative UI · Product Design + Leadership

I build AI agents that people can use, understand, and trust. I'm an independent Staff Applied AI Engineer working with CopilotKit, combining hands-on engineering with a background in UX design and product leadership.

  • 23.7K+ combined GitHub stars across five open-source AI projects I've built or contributed to.

Portfolio · Resume (PDF) · Resume (plain text) · LinkedIn · Contact

Star total: 23,753 across OpenMuse, Open Intelligent UI, OpenDots, OpenBot, and OpenTag on October 24, 2026. These are shared project totals, not personal ownership or unique users. Impressions refer to project launches.

Selected engineering work

Project My contribution
OpenMuse Solo-built the initial release in one day; shipped persistent browser interaction, human takeover, and generative interfaces across mobile and web. Code · Case study
Open Intelligent UI Built streaming visualizations, a standalone Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, sandboxed UI execution, and adoption telemetry. Formerly OpenGenerativeUI. Case study

OpenDots Solo-built and released the initial version: an agent workspace with persistent documents, revision-conflict checks, and server-enforced access. Initial implementation.
OpenBot Engineered action approvals and execution recovery, including mid-execution corrections and recovery from stalled streams.
OpenTag Built a reusable Slack/Teams agent starter with a LangGraph research backend and readable approvals for external writes. Code · Case study

Product judgment, backed by operating results

My product and design background shapes how I build: identify the user problem, design the interaction, choose the architecture, and measure the outcome.

Work Scope and outcome
Nona · Selected production project · 2025 Architected an eight-agent real-estate concierge using Python, FastAPI, Google ADK, Gemini, Next.js, and Supabase. Supported 37,737 new users and 44,468 sessions in three months.
Full Scale Ventures · Director of Product Management · Nov 2024–Feb 2026 Led venture-studio product direction in a 300+ developer organization. Established AI-assisted practices across 100+ prototypes, cutting validation from two weeks to one day.
GoTeam / MultiplAI · Director, Enterprise AI and AI SaaS Portfolio · Apr–Sep 2024 Led product and engineering delivery for InterviewRoom.ai workflows spanning 61,151 applicants and 15,332 automated interviews, reducing time-to-hire from 45 to 18 days.
TripGuru · Lead Product Manager · Aug 2023–Apr 2024 Led product strategy across 10 countries, including UX and delivery of its finance-reporting portal. Championed AI support that cut response time from two minutes to 10 seconds.
bneXt · BI Solution Architect → Product Manager · Jun 2022–Aug 2023 Led BI delivery across SAP and web development, and led the timeX team to win the October 19, 2022 SAP Hack2Build demo day, ahead of runner-up Bosch Vietnam.

Founder work

At Chalk Agents, I build agent infrastructure, including Folderbase, an open-source Rust database core for durable file identity, version history, and policy, with a CLI and TypeScript SDK. I also developed a prelaunch agent-runtime MVP with PostgreSQL, tenant isolation, retries, and restart persistence.

Tools and engineering focus

Languages and product: TypeScript, Python, Rust, React, Next.js, FastAPI, React Native / Expo.

Agents and interfaces: CopilotKit, AG-UI, A2UI, MCP, LangGraph, Google ADK; tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, generative UI, browser automation, memory, and human approvals.

Systems: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker, GCP, CI/CD, access control, observability, and execution recovery.

Recognition and community

  • LinkedIn Top Voice for Product Management (2023) and Stellar PH Top 100 Brightest Minds Under 30 (2024).
  • Five hackathon prize finishes: SAP Hack2Build demo-day champion (2022); Diliman Solutions Challenge grand winner (2022); AI Conference Hack Day third place (2025); WeaveHacks-2 Google sponsor prize (2025); Wordware OpenClaw Hack Night Best Use of CopilotKit (2026).
  • Founder of AI Cebu; invited judge for AI hackathons, including AI Tinkerers and Daytona events. Talks and events.
  • Postgraduate Diploma in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Asian Institute of Management.

Hi there, I'm Jeffrey Girard!

Open Courses:

Statistics Software:

  • intraclass - A stable R package for calculating intraclass correlations (ICCs).
  • bsync - An experimental R package for conducting behavioral synchrony analyses.

  • datawizard - A stable R package for data wrangling and statistical transformation.

I engineer quality systems that turn software change into attributable evidence —
and evidence into bounded, decision-grade confidence.


◈  QE Domains

▦  Test Architecture


Designed for Reproducibility · Attribution · Evidence-backed Decisions


✦ Engineering Thesis

I treat quality engineering as the discipline of reducing uncertainty about change. I design systems that collect evidence at the narrowest layer sufficient to support a conclusion, separate reasoning from authority, and preserve the scope and limits of every oracle. A green state should make explicit what the evidence establishes, for which subject and revision, in which environment, through which oracle, and under which execution boundary.

Reason deliberately. Execute deterministically. Prove with attributable evidence.
A conclusion should be traceable to the exact subject, revision, environment, execution, oracle, and artifacts that support it.
AI may interpret, diagnose, rank risk, and propose; deterministic policy and validation retain authority over side effects and terminal pass/fail state.
Keep failure domains separable so a broken schema, resolver, transport, browser state, device session, threshold, baseline, dependency, or environment produces the right signal.
Every oracle has a scope and a limit. A green visual diff, accessibility scan, contract check, or CI job may claim only what its evidence can actually establish.
CI should make runtime, dependency, target, security, and evidence contracts explicit and verifiable; a green workflow should claim no more than those signals establish.
Mutation, external integration, sustained load, secrets, and other high-impact capabilities belong behind explicit ownership, authorization, budgets, and fail-closed boundaries.

Confidence does not scale with automation volume alone.

It is earned when evidence is traceable, oracles are explicit, and failure is attributable.
